{{Top|leg|canon=Chauffeur droid}}
An '''auto-chauffeur'''<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> or '''chauffeur droid'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] responsible for driving vehicles. They were usually part of the household staff of wealthy individuals.<ref name="DESB" />
